column4: The career memoir relates personal experience to social change. That perspective is not itself an explicit declaration of activism; the earlier broad movement-purpose inference is insufficient under revised V5. Motivational and selection limits remain in the score.

The memoir narrates organizing, travel and listening. A history of an activist life is not automatically an explicit activist declaration; revised V5 permits its political commitments unless a stronger textual ground is shown.

The commission chair's account explains reconciliation and proposes forgiveness as an institutional and moral response. Religious motivation and a civil vision do not alone establish a base or derived religious teaching text; the previous broad V5 rationale is withdrawn.
V3 remains: illness, mortality and individual fulfillment dominate this life account. A business career in the background does not establish a developed transferable business model.
V3 remains: the illustrated volume celebrates a designer's style, homes, clients and life. The retained scope is a portrait rather than a sustained account of design or production mechanisms.

The conversion memoir explicitly argues for a new political allegiance and against the former movement. That declared ideological purpose remains V5; conversion as a personal experience alone would not.
The work explicitly launches a campaign to change business around social and environmental purposes. This declared collective-action program remains V5, beyond a general management proposal.
V3 remains: personal recollections, observations and angling supply the principal content. The identified nonfiction work lacks a developed transferable account in the reviewed evidence.
V3 remains: personal rise, criminal justice and recovery dominate the celebrity memoir. The reviewed material offers little developed production or institutional model beyond the individual's story.
V3 remains: the career memoir principally records personal experience and celebrity formation. The reviewed scope does not develop a substantial transferable account of media production.
V3 remains: artistic persona, memory and self-mythology dominate over reusable explanation. The work is presented as autobiography, so fantasy-like recollection alone does not justify H1.

The political memoir defends a leadership stance and policy record. Participant bias and a preferred policy do not automatically constitute an explicit ideological manifesto or activism declaration under revised V5; existing interested-witness limits remain.
V4 remains: the central new payoff depends on an emerging third-wave internet forecast and investment agenda. Memoir and partnership observations do not establish the predicted transformation.

The work expressly promotes a women's-leadership movement and collective workplace reform. Its declared civil-activist manifesto purpose remains V5; incidental career advice does not make it primarily a technical manual.

The media polemic explicitly mobilizes a class-political response against the ideology it labels woke. That declared ideological intervention remains V5; no separate universal factual-error claim is inferred.

The memoir explicitly makes defense of capitalism and the American Dream its governing ideological message. This declared doctrine-promoting purpose remains V5, beyond a business narrative with incidental political preferences.

The explanatory case history examines corporate denial and proposes institutional responses. A public-interest conclusion is an allowed proposal; the earlier finding did not establish an explicit activist declaration independent of those recommendations.

The political memoir argues for opportunity-zone policy and a preferred approach to poverty. Revised V5 permits policy proposals; the earlier record relied on the fact of advocacy rather than a distinct explicit manifesto or activism declaration.

The selected entrepreneurial stories explicitly advance supply-side doctrine as the organizing explanation and preferred economic order. That declared ideological purpose remains V5; ordinary support for enterprise alone would not.

V3 remains: the illustrated shoe-and-celebrity celebration supplies too little transferable explanation beyond objects and anecdotes. The design subject does not make the book a technical instruction manual.

V4 remains: promised institutional transformation through blockchain is central and exceeds the demonstrated deployment evidence. General explanation passes H2, but premature revolutionary claims remain a separate gate.
V1 remains on the coauthor's account of constructing a misleading success persona central to the dealmaking memoir. Revised H2 and V5 do not repair the autobiographical integrity problem.
V3 remains: photographs and an essay chiefly document a particular installation and collaboration. Little reusable explanatory content survives removal of that event-specific artwork.

V3 remains: photographs of individual interiors and aesthetic reflections are the main payload. The retained scope does not establish sustained mechanistic or strategic explanation beyond those spaces.

The monetary argument expressly derives its preferred order from a religious-moral framework and a declared anti-state monetary doctrine. This ideological and religious purpose remains V5; the assessment is not based merely on favoring private money.

The account of evolved order and the limits of design is a sustained political-economic argument. A preference for markets over socialism is not automatically an explicit manifesto under revised V5; the prior inferential and counterargument limits remain scored.

The book expressly promotes an anti-fiat, pro-Bitcoin social doctrine and attributes broad social failures to the disfavored order. That governing ideological purpose remains V5; the existing causal reservations are not converted into an unproved new V1.

The work primarily develops economic history and social theory about market society. Its proposed social settlement is an allowed vision; the old V5 decision acknowledged this explanatory interpretation but used the broader advocacy test.

The automation thought experiment and proposed income/tax arrangements form an explanatory policy argument. Revised V5 expressly permits such proposals; the earlier record does not independently establish an explicit manifesto or serious V4.

The work is explicitly presented as a manifesto to replace mainstream economics and reshape policy around ecological survival. That primary declared form meets revised V5, independently of useful criticism of economic models.

The dialogue develops proposals for Japan's competitiveness through firms, education and institutions. A national reform vision is allowed by revised V5; the old finding inferred exclusion from prescriptive purpose alone.

The labor-market analysis proposes representation, security and rights for a newly defined class. A political remedy does not itself establish an explicit activist declaration; the prior broad class-category and causal limits remain in the score.

V4 remains independently: the principal argument depends on a coming US bankruptcy. The explicit political campaign to reverse monetary institutions also retains its recorded V5 basis; neither historical examples nor conditional phrasing validates the forecast.

The framework explains interaction among markets, states and communities, then proposes localism. The publisher explicitly separates explanatory value from remedies; revised V5 permits these institutional proposals rather than treating them as a manifesto.

The dialogue criticizes trade and development arrangements and proposes alternatives. Revised V5 permits political/environmental visions; the previous broad advocacy rationale does not by itself establish an explicit manifesto. Causal overreach remains scored.

The argument defends inequality through claims about innovation and incentives and offers policy remedies. A preferred political-economic arrangement alone is insufficient for revised V5; selected evidence and normative leaps retain their existing penalties.

The pamphlet explicitly presents the libertarian monetary doctrine against state control. This declared ideological teaching purpose remains V5, beyond a neutral description of banking or a limited policy proposal.

The sustained defense of trade integration is an evidence-based public argument with institutional proposals. A pro-globalization inclination is allowed; the earlier record did not establish an explicit movement declaration or independently serious V2.

The pamphlet explicitly advances free-market labor doctrine against unions and state intervention through categorical wage claims. The retained ideological teaching purpose meets V5; the economic topic itself is not the gate.

The work explicitly promotes a sound-money social doctrine with Bitcoin as its vehicle. That governing ideological program remains V5; it is not rejected merely for analyzing cryptocurrency or proposing an institutional change.

The public argument develops opportunity costs and indirect effects through economic examples. Its market inclination is allowed by revised V5; the previous veto inferred ideological status from policy conclusions without a distinct explicit declaration.

The sustained argument investigates planning, knowledge and coercion and defends liberal limits. A political-philosophical inclination is expressly allowed; the existing evidence does not establish an explicit activist manifesto distinct from that argument.
The reported monetary cases explicitly serve Bitcoin adoption and human-rights activism. The declared movement purpose remains V5; this is based on the work's program, not the author's employment.

The broad theoretical account of social action, coordination and incentives is a sustained expert argument. Revised H2 permits this structure, while a liberal economic inclination does not automatically make the treatise an explicit ideological manifesto under revised V5.

The diagnosis of capitalist institutions proposes ethical repairs and social obligations. The publisher describes pragmatic remedies rather than ideological revival; revised V5 expressly permits this vision. Normative and implementation gaps remain scoring limits.

V4 remains: the edited outlook's principal value depends on China's next five years and near-term investment implications. Contributor expertise and general mechanisms do not remove the dated forecasting frame.

The comparative argument explains profit accounting and bureaucratic management. A market preference is allowed under revised V5; the earlier finding relied on ideological inclination without a distinct explicit activism declaration.

The book explicitly campaigns for abolition of the Federal Reserve and a changed monetary order. That declared political manifesto remains V5, separately from the merits of its institutional observations.

The essays analyze policy disputes and propose responses. Persuading governments on policy does not itself make an essay collection an explicit activist manifesto; revised V5 permits those proposals while retaining advocacy limits in the score.

The multivolume work develops a political-philosophical account of law and institutions. Its proposed liberal constitutional order is an allowed vision; the old rule's blanket treatment of normative programs no longer suffices.

The book explains knowledge-coordination constraints and critiques planning proposals. A market-oriented institutional alternative is allowed under revised V5; asymmetric comparisons stay in the score rather than becoming an unsupported new veto.

The work explicitly presents a national collective program for Black economic empowerment. That declared civil/political mobilization remains V5; broad agenda structure keeps it distinct from a narrow technical manual.

The corporate-purpose argument develops a reform agenda, which revised V5 permits as a proposal. A reviewer's loose manifesto praise is not enough to establish the work as an explicit declaration; existing implementation limits remain.

The account proposes American renewal through education, infrastructure, fiscal choices and innovation. A national policy vision is expressly allowed; the prior broad advocacy rationale does not independently establish an explicit manifesto.

The industrial-competition argument proposes European integration and a response to corporate scale. Civilizational preferences and institutional visions are expressly allowed; the earlier V5 finding rested on prescriptive purpose alone.

The pamphlet explicitly promotes an anti-government ideological interpretation of taxation and public institutions. That declared doctrine remains V5; no unverified procedure-manual classification or new factual accusation is added.

The memoir explains social-enterprise and patient-capital experience. A call for social improvement does not by itself make this narrative an explicit activism declaration; revised V5 permits its proposed approach to poverty.
This identified Norberg work is an explicitly named capitalist manifesto. Revised V5 directly retains that category; the corrected Swedish original identity and publication year remain unchanged.

The financial argument connects beliefs, markets and institutions and proposes reforms to protect an open society. That normative vision is allowed by revised V5; weakly specified reflexivity and crisis extrapolation remain scoring limits.

The monetary argument proposes a different fiscal approach and distinguishes resource from monetary constraints. Revised V5 permits policy proposals; the existing record does not establish a separate explicit manifesto or serious V1 despite contested assumptions.

The economic account explains debt, trade and reconstruction constraints and recommends a different peace settlement. A policy intervention is expressly allowed; the old V5 finding confused advocacy with an explicit manifesto. Participant bias and disputed estimates remain scored.

V4 remains: speculative futures of transformed humanity and dataism carry the main new payoff. Labeling them possibilities limits but does not remove the central dependence on an unvalidated future scenario.

The revisionist history argues against New Deal policies. A political-economic interpretation is allowed under revised V5; the earlier evidence establishes viewpoint rather than an explicit activist declaration or independently established serious V1.

V4 remains: the central payoff is a coming crisis predicted through a four-stage historical cycle. Selected analogies do not establish predictive validity; the rule revision does not change that defect.

The work explicitly declares a political doctrine of legitimate law based on natural property rights and rejects redistributive legislation. The retained manifesto purpose meets V5, beyond an incidental legal preference.

The commentary develops political and institutional arguments through Roman history. Republican inclination and proposed arrangements are allowed under revised V5; this philosophical-historical work is not an operational manual under H2.

The imperial history draws contemporary lessons from its interpretation of British institutions. A civilizational inclination or policy analogy is expressly allowed; the older V5 rationale does not establish an explicit manifesto. Counterfactual-selection limits remain.

V1 remains: the lost-civilization argument relies on unsupported map correspondences and myth links. The prior detailed comparison challenges the central Antarctic evidential bridge, not merely a peripheral historical detail.
V4 remains: the recurring generational typology is used to forecast America's future to 2069 without validated predictive support. Historical resemblance alone does not establish the central cycle.

The selected socialist experiments and leaders explicitly support an ideological case against socialism. That declared doctrine-opposition purpose remains V5; the decision does not assume every historical criticism is false.

V4 remains: the book's central contribution is a future American civilization inferred from present cultural signs. The speculative value proposition is independent of the now-permitted civilizational preference.

V3 remains: local encounters, legends and literary observation dominate the travel account. The reviewed scope offers little developed transferable explanation; reconstruction doubts stay in E without an unproved new V1.

The civilizational typology and policy interpretation are analytical and prescriptive. Revised V5 expressly permits civilizational inclinations; the old Western-preservation rationale no longer suffices. Broad categories and causal attribution remain scored cautiously.

V2 remains on the separately assessed allegiance-dependent self-justification of conquest. Command and logistics observations survive, but a participant account organized to vindicate the political beneficiary does not independently validate that central defense.

The book explicitly promotes citizen action against an alleged concealed monetary scheme. That declared anti-central-bank activist purpose remains V5; the existing weak conspiratorial inference is retained in the counterfactual rather than expanded without evidence.

The account argues for a liberal-democratic historical destination. A political-philosophical vision is expressly allowed by revised V5; the earlier veto rested on normative direction rather than an explicit activist manifesto. Teleological limits remain scored.

The humorous history proposes that retaining monarchy would have been preferable. A political counterfactual is an allowed view; the older V5 finding did not establish an explicit movement declaration or serious independent ideological capture.
The essay expressly explains and defends Marxist historical doctrine. That declared ideological teaching purpose remains V5, even though agency-and-structure questions have transferable value.

V3 remains: timelines and visual reference chiefly organize names, dates and succession without developed causal explanation. It is general historical reference, not specialist technical reference under H2.

The essays combine historical explanation and public-policy judgments. Advocacy for social democracy is an allowed political inclination unless an explicit manifesto is established; the earlier broad intervention rationale is insufficient.

V4 remains: the investment case depends on future adoption and a very large prospective price increase. Conditional phrasing does not establish that central forecast, and narrative financial argument is not a technical operation manual.

The exposition endorses a privileged Biblical difference and Christian revelation as a central theoretical pillar. That constructive religious teaching remains V5; interdisciplinary scholarly explanation passes the narrowed H2 gate.
The narrative directly teaches nondual enlightenment and ego dissolution. It is derived spiritual doctrine under V5, not verified fiction or a primarily technical procedure manual.
The collected talks directly teach spiritual liberation through self-knowledge. Rejection of organized religion does not remove the central derived spiritual doctrine under V5.
The assembled autobiography explicitly conveys meditation and enlightenment as spiritual teaching. Calling the ideal religionless does not remove the derived religious purpose under V5.
The talks explain a spiritual worldview of fear, love and liberation. They remain derived religious teaching under V5 rather than an operational technical course under H2.
The conversations teach nondual awakening and a dream-world metaphysics as doctrine. That spiritual purpose supports V5; no unsupported factual-conspiracy accusation is inferred from the subtitle.

The book explains ego, suffering and awakening as spiritual teaching. Revised V5 retains this derived religious category; the separate audio training program must not be mistaken for this book's structure.
The narrative teaches awakening and self-dissolution. It is a derived spiritual text under V5, not military history or a primarily procedural training course.
The work advances its own spiritual metaphysics through dialogue and interpretation. Criticizing conventional religion does not remove that derived religious teaching purpose under V5.
The talks interpret Zen texts and enlightenment as teachings. This is derived religious exposition under revised V5; questions and examples do not turn it into a technical methods manual.

The edited lectures advance Taoist and Zen accounts of self and reality, not merely describe their history. That constructive spiritual teaching remains a V5 ground despite philosophical applications.
The central arguments concern spiritual liberation, immortality and attachment. Incidental techniques do not dominate the structure, but the explicit religious teaching remains V5.
The anthology directly teaches spiritual freedom, transformation and awakening. Its calendar format does not make it a procedural manual; derived religious purpose keeps V5 applicable.
The identified anthology in the Spiritual Masters series presents prayer, God-seeking and nonviolent political teaching. Its explicit derived religious and activist content remains V5.
The collected talks teach consciousness and transcendence as spiritual reality. Their discursive structure passes H2, but the derived religious purpose remains V5.

The moral biographies develop a proposed ethic of character and humility. Religious influences and moral ideals do not automatically make this comparative argument a derived religious text; the prior broad spiritual-purpose inference is insufficient under revised V5.
The sustained argument explicitly defends sacred experience and the religious worldview. This constructive religious apologetic purpose remains V5, beyond an incidental civilizational inclination.
The talks explicitly teach spiritual freedom and truth or God as the governing aim of education and life. That derived religious teaching remains V5; school use alone does not establish H2.
The selected anthology directly teaches spiritual self, truth and liberation. Rejection of institutions or ideology does not remove this derived religious purpose under revised V5.
